title: Rule vs. Consequence: Dissociable Internal Representations of Moral Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differential responses (logit shifts) to rule-framed versus consequence-framed moral questions using a 2x2 factorial dataset, linear probing, and activation steering.

Measuring logit difference shifts and conflict pair behavioral dissociation to identify learned priors in RLHF training that associate rule-framing with permissive judgments, contrasting it with a global acceptance bias.
